text:
Ava: quick FYI — p99 on /v1/generate jumped from ~160ms to ~520ms at 12:03 UTC. p50/p95 pretty flat. Region-level dashboard (us-east) shows p99 ~200ms.

Josh: that smells like sampling/origin mismatch. Did anything route-level change or fire a quota fallback?

Ava: console query I ran:
```
SELECT percentile(ms, [50,95,99])
FROM latency
WHERE endpoint='/v1/generate' AND ts >= '2025-01-12T11:55:00Z' AND ts <= '2025-01-12T12:10:00Z'
GROUP BY region, sample_origin
```

Kevin: note: our rollup path merges origin-less t-digests for region/route views. Endpoint pages recompute from backend histograms after cache filtering. So mixed-origin rollups can hide small-origin tails.

Ava: interesting — endpoint view (backend-only) p99 ~520ms, region rollup p99 ~200ms. How do we avoid false paging?

Liz: UX idea: a thin origin-banner above the percentile card that lists origins + effective N and a colored confidence band. For example: origin-banner: gateway(2.1k) | cache(1.9k) | backend(62) — confidence: LOW.

Josh: love that. Also show per-percentile effective_N and a tiny tooltip: "Effective N = estimated independent samples contributing to this percentile. Low N -> high variance."

incident-bot: quota-fallback applied client=beta-inc at 2025-01-12T12:02:18Z (policy=cost-saver-v1).

Kevin: counts I pulled for that window:
```
window: 2025-01-12T11:55Z - 2025-01-12T12:10Z
gateway: 2,100
cache_hit: 1,900
backend: 62
```

Ava: backend N tiny — explains noisy tail. Propose bumping visible threshold: show yellow low-confidence when N<200, red when N<50. Also add a one-click "open raw sample" to expand the backend histogram.

Liz: UI sketch: origin-banner + per-percentile small pill "N=62" + a triangular warning icon when N below threshold. Hover expands counts and a sparkline. Minimal visual change so dashboard stays compact.

Josh: I'll file an RFC and tracking ticket, include Ava's query and Kevin's counts. Runbook update: "If region/route percentiles differ from endpoint percentiles, check origin-banner and effective_N before escalating." Tagging eng-platform and oncall.

Kevin: I'll emit a metric named `percentile_effective_n` per origin+percentile in the next infra rollout so the console can read it.

Ava: also flagging that recent gateway batching push means many short requests are sampled together at gateway which suppresses gateway tail; long seqs often bypass batching and surface in backend histograms. Sequence-length stratifier could help.

Josh: good catch. Add sequence-length bucket to RFC. Liz: can you prototype the banner copy + tooltip? Keep copy low-fi.

Liz: will draft PR with mock and copy: https://git.internal/redwood/console/pull/5910 — includes banner, N pill, and warning states.

Ava: thanks — this should cut down noisy wakeups. cc @eng-platform :eyes:
